name: 47546 · Jasper, IN
findings: ZIP 47546 (Jasper) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 47546 (Jasper) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
